name: com.sa.inbetween.sa.timeline
description: Author generations in Unity's Timeline window. Chain Track: one row of blocks (run, jump, land, ...); every gap is an in-between that is generated, baked and played on the Generated track, and the whole chain is written as one .saclip. Generation Track: Source, Generate, Start/Goal Pose, Retarget / Bake and Export clips, then Bake Timeline writes the same .saclip, .anim and .fbx files as the Inbetween Bridge. Also: right-click two clips on an Animation Track for an Inbetween bridge.
